enemy-044-upp-vanguard.designLock: UPP Vanguard is an original Aliens: Tantalus Frontier PROJECT_ADAPTATION grounded in the published Union of Progressive Peoples military context, not a published UPP class, rank, named uniform or exact character model. Preserve the project V56 identity: a compact, mobile human assault trooper in practical layered field protection, a low close-fitting combat helmet, restrained communications and ammunition equipment, and one stable UPP-pattern pulse/assault rifle whose angular stamped-metal silhouette is clearly distinct from the USCM M41A. Use desaturated gray-olive and green-gray fabric, charcoal webbing, dark oxidized metal and limited dull red identification accents. Armor remains light-to-medium and utilitarian: a short segmented chest carrier with small shoulder and forearm protection, never a bulky powered suit. The helmet has a shallow rounded shell, short front brow, protected ears, narrow dark visor/goggle slit and a compact left-side communications module; the face remains partly readable below it. The rifle has a long straight upper receiver, short vented shroud, conventional stock, curved detachable magazine and compact optic, with no M41A carry-handle/grenade-launcher silhouette. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Preserve one identical individual, weapon, helmet, armor segmentation, pouch layout, palette, anatomical scale and handedness across idle, move, attack, death and reload. This is a fan-made project interpretation; no official bitmap, sprite, illustration or uniform may be copied or traced, and canonExact remains false.

identityBoundary.published: The Union of Progressive Peoples and a wider frontier-war/faction/equipment context are present in licensed ALIEN material. Aliens: Infestation is a licensed side-scrolling ALIENS title with enemy-soldier combat and expanded-universe framing.
identityBoundary.projectAuthored: The Vanguard role name, exact armor assembly, helmet geometry, rifle silhouette, palette allocation, pouch layout and all animation poses are Tantalus-authored.
identityBoundary.negativeFindingScope: No inspected primary or licensed public page establishes a standardized named UPP Vanguard class or one definitive Vanguard uniform/model. This scoped finding is not an exhaustive claim about every paid publication page or unseen illustration.
identityBoundary.canonPosition: Faction correspondence does not make the generated character canon-exact; canonExact is permanently false for this adaptation.

topology.rule: Realistic adult human anatomy; helmet, rifle sling, pouches and antenna never become limbs. Both hands retain stable readable contact with the same rifle except during the authored reload steps.

referenceLock.silhouette: Compact elite infantry profile, slightly forward tactical posture, low helmet, short layered torso armor, narrow practical backpack/radio contour and one shoulder-length rifle. Mobile rather than tank-like; no powered exoskeleton.

palette.secondary: charcoal webbing, gloves, boots and dark oxidized gunmetal
palette.armor: matte muted sage/olive plates with worn edges
palette.accent: small dull red identification tab or cable only
palette.forbidden: bright parade red, giant stars, glossy black sci-fi armor, neon, blue USCM camouflage or randomized clip recolors

referenceLock.armor: Light-to-medium modular field protection: short segmented chest carrier, modest shoulder caps, forearm guards, knee pads and compact rear radio/utility pack. Fabric remains visible at abdomen, upper arms and thighs. No Colonial Marine M3 armor copy and no full sealed spacesuit.
referenceLock.helmet: Low shallow rounded ballistic shell with short brow, protected ears, narrow smoked visor/goggle slit, chin strap and compact left communications block/short antenna. Lower nose, jaw or respirator edge remains readable. No USCM lobster-tail helmet, Soviet steel helmet, gas-mask caricature or full opaque astronaut dome.
referenceLock.equipment: Compact left-side radio/comms, four restrained rifle magazines, one utility pouch, canteen/medical pouch and simple sling. Gear remains identical and attached across all clips; no floating loose accessories.

weapon.identity: Tantalus UPP-pattern pulse/assault rifle, original project design
weapon.silhouette: Long straight angular upper receiver, short vented forward shroud, conventional fixed skeletal stock, curved detachable magazine, compact low optic and short muzzle device.
weapon.handling: Right-facing muzzle; stock seated at the shoulder for fire, muzzle safely low-ready for locomotion, same magazine and charging control during reload.
weapon.prohibitions: No M41A carry handle, under-barrel grenade launcher or counter block; no AK-47 replica, modern real-world branded rifle, smartgun, railgun, plasma beam, bayonet or weapon morphing.

referenceLock.facing: Strict orthographic gameplay side view facing right in every future pose; face, visor, armor layers, hands, magazine and complete muzzle remain readable.

scale.gameplayRole: Mobile human assault elite, taller than low creatures but not larger than other standing human combatants.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure helmet crown-to-boot-sole standing height on comparable upright idle/reload poses and cross-check shoulder-to-hip armor seam distance; never use rifle length, recoil reach or corpse width.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; manual physical-root review required after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project the pelvis center to the active boot support/contact plane; never anchor to rifle, backpack, antenna, kneepad or detached magazine.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete soldier and all attached equipment per cell; helmet antenna, stock, muzzle, boots and every reload object remain inside generous gutters.
sourceContract.identityScale: One common individual, weapon and physical scale across all five clips; no automatic per-pose correction.

idle.rule: Muzzle remains low-ready to the right; no aim/fire, patrol step or perspective turn.

move.rule: Controlled armed jog with the same two-hand low-ready grip and stable kit; no translation across cells.

attack.rule: One short controlled rifle shot/burst; no weapon redesign, projectile beam, giant flash or left-facing recoil.

death.rule: Irreversible human fall. Rifle may remain slung or land adjacent but cannot vanish, fire independently or become a second prop actor.

reload.rule: One mechanically coherent detachable-magazine reload using the same rifle, magazine well, curved magazine and support hand. Exactly one controlled magazine object; no duplicated floating magazine.

prohibitions: No claim that UPP Vanguard is a published class, uniform or canon-exact model.
No USCM marine recolor, M3 armor copy, M41A, colonial helmet or blue camouflage.
No historical Soviet/Chinese uniform cosplay, giant star, hammer-and-sickle, propaganda poster styling or ethnic caricature.
No powered exoskeleton, glossy superhero armor, full astronaut suit, oversized backpack, cape or railgun.
No weapon, helmet, armor, pouch, palette, handedness or body-scale drift between clips.
No left-facing pose, three-quarter camera, crop, cell contact, scenery, floor, shadow, text, logo, UI or copied official/licensed bitmap.
